title: FileUploader
description: Fiori file uploader: input-styled field with browse/clear icons, multiple files, accept, max size, drag & drop (ui5-file-uploader). Upload transport is up to the caller.

usage.summary: Select local files for a caller-managed upload flow.
useWhen: Let users choose a local file, or drop files into a field, for upload.
Prefer it for single-file selection; let the application perform the upload and report its outcome.
Use accept to filter the native chooser and maxFileSize to reject oversized selections; validate file types, including dropped files, in the caller.

avoidWhen.when: Manage an existing collection with individual deletion, upload status and retry actions.
Run an action unrelated to selecting files.
